text:
If you're waiting on that promised sunshine, it's on its way but taking its time. That mostly cloudy start with the lingering fog is set to break up through the afternoon, clearing toward a high near 80 with a light north breeze. Should be a solid stretch out there for the back half of the day, and the lake's in good shape too, waves a foot or less and water sitting at a comfortable 73.

Tonight stays easy, partly cloudy and dropping to around 61, nothing to plan around. The next thing on the radar is Wednesday afternoon, when a shower or a rumble of thunder becomes possible, especially after 2pm. It's not a washout, just keep half an eye on the sky if you've got outdoor plans into the evening. Good waterfront window today through sunset; I'd have any Wednesday plans done by early afternoon just in case.

Sun early, then afternoon showers and a rumble of thunder move in, high near 81.
Back to mostly sunny and dry, high near 81, a solid day to be outside.
Sunny and pleasant, high near 82, the pick of the week so far.
Mostly sunny through the day, but watch for a stray shower after 2, high near 83.
Showers and thunderstorms likely most of the day and into the night, high only near 80.
Unsettled again with scattered showers and storms, high near 77, coolest day of the stretch.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST: BURLINGTON, Vt. (WCAX) — Happy Tuesday! Our Tuesday morning starts with some patchy dense fog. Fog should gradually begin to lift through the mid to late morning hours. After it lifts, we will be left with a good deal of sunshine. However, clouds and showers could prove to be a little more stubborn across the eastern half of the area through the day ahead. High temperatures for the day climb back into the mid and upper 70s and close to 80 by this afternoon. Tonight, mainly clear to partly cloudy skies stick around as lows fall into the 50s.
